DLG-SC-LOC-029-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの通知についてのご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're asking about the notice you have with you, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-029-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。住所の確認票が届きましたが、引っ越した日を書く欄が見つかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通知の記入欄を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I received an address confirmation form, but I can't find where to write the date I moved.
DLG-SC-LOC-029-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the entry field on the notice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの「異動日」の欄です。新しい住所に住み始めた日をご記入ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: It's this 'date of change' field. Please enter the date you began living at the new address.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 四月一日から住んでいます。通知の宛先は前の住所のままです。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 居住開始日と宛先の相違を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I've lived there since April first. The notice is still addressed to my old address.
DLG-SC-LOC-029-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the date you began living there and the difference in the addressed location. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、新住所の欄も記入してください。建物名と部屋番号はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then fill in the new-address field too. Is there a building name and room number?

DLG-SC-LOC-029-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: あります。建物名が長いのですが、欄の外に続けて書いてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 長い建物名の記入方法を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. The building name is long; may I continue writing outside the field?
DLG-SC-LOC-029-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask how to enter a long building name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、この用紙では余白に続けて書けます。文字が重ならないようにお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, on this form you may continue in the margin. Please make sure the text doesn't overlap.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 書けました。この封筒で郵送するのと、ここに出すのでは、どちらがいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 提出方法を二つ挙げて尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've filled it in. Which is better: mailing it in this envelope or handing it in here?
DLG-SC-LOC-029-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask which of two submission methods to use. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この窓口でも受け取れます。通知と一緒にお出しいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We can receive it at this counter too. Could you submit it together with the notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-029-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、確認票と通知をこちらに出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 記入済み用紙と通知を提出する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I'll hand in the confirmation form and notice here.
DLG-SC-LOC-029-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Submit the completed form and notice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お預かりします。ご来庁ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll take those. Thank you for visiting the office.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お荷物を送られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to send a parcel?

DLG-SC-LOC-029-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。大阪の家族へ、服と本を送りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 宛先地域と内容物を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I'd like to send clothes and books to my family in Osaka.
DLG-SC-LOC-029-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: State the destination area and contents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 箱をこちらにお願いします。お届けする時間帯のご希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please put the box here. Do you have a preferred delivery time window?

DLG-SC-LOC-029-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 家族は夕方に帰るので、十八時から二十時を希望します。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 受取人に合う時間帯を指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: My family gets home in the evening, so I'd like six to eight p.m.
DLG-SC-LOC-029-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Specify a time window suitable for the recipient. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その時間帯で受け付けます。こちらの箱は八十サイズで、送料は千百円です。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll accept that time window. This box is size eighty, and shipping is eleven hundred yen.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 追跡番号は付きますか。家族にも知らせたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 追跡番号の有無を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Does it come with a tracking number? I'd like to tell my family too.
DLG-SC-LOC-029-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether there is a tracking number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、控えに載ります。差出人のお名前と住所もお書きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, it will be on your receipt copy. Please also write the sender's name and address.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 書きました。受取人の電話番号を一桁書き間違えました。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 伝票の誤記を申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've written them. I made a mistake in one digit of the recipient's phone number.
DLG-SC-LOC-029-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report a mistake on the shipping form. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その数字を二重線で消して、正しい番号を近くに書いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Cross out that digit with two lines and write the correct number nearby.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 直しました。十八時から二十時の指定でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 修正して時間帯指定を確定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've corrected it. Please specify six to eight p.m.
DLG-SC-LOC-029-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Correct it and confirm the delivery time window. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、控えをどうぞ。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Here is your receipt copy. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お振り込みの手続きですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you making a bank transfer?

DLG-SC-LOC-029-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家賃を振り込みたいです。大家さんから届いた口座情報はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家賃と振込先資料を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to transfer my rent. Here are the account details my landlord sent.
DLG-SC-LOC-029-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the rent payment and destination-account documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 金額は六万円ですね。振込人のお名前は、ご本人のお名前でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The amount is sixty thousand yen, correct? Should the sender's name be your own name?

DLG-SC-LOC-029-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 名前の前に部屋番号の三〇二を付けるように言われています。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 部屋番号付き名義を指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I've been told to put my room number, three-oh-two, before my name.
DLG-SC-LOC-029-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Specify the sender name with your room number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、この振込人名の欄に部屋番号とお名前をお書きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then write your room number and name in this sender-name field.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 書きました。手数料は、六万円から差し引かれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 手数料の扱いを聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've written them. Will the fee be deducted from the sixty thousand yen?
DLG-SC-LOC-029-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask how the fee is handled. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: いいえ、この手続きでは手数料四百四十円を別にいただきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: No, for this procedure we collect the four-hundred-and-forty-yen fee separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 大家さんには六万円が届いて、支払いは六万四百四十円ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 受取額と支払総額を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: So my landlord receives sixty thousand yen, and I pay sixty thousand four hundred and forty yen?
DLG-SC-LOC-029-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the amount received and total paid. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。内容をこちらでお確かめのうえ、お支払いをお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Please check the details here and then pay.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 口座番号も合っています。この内容で振り込んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 口座情報を確認して実行を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: The account number is correct too. Please make the transfer with these details.
DLG-SC-LOC-029-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the account details and ask for the transfer to be carried out. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 控えをお持ち帰りください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take your receipt copy with you. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 御朱印の受付はこちらです。御朱印帳はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is the goshuin calligraphy-seal reception. Do you have a seal book?

DLG-SC-LOC-029-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。この帳面の、次の空いているページにお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 御朱印を頼むページを指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Please use the next blank page in this book.
DLG-SC-LOC-029-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Specify the page for the goshuin seal. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらのページですね。受付番号の札をお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: This page, correct? I'll give you a numbered claim tag.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 連れが先に大仏殿へ行ったのですが、書いていただく間に合流できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 預けている間の外出を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: My companion has gone ahead to the Great Buddha Hall. May I join them while you're writing it?
DLG-SC-LOC-029-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may leave while the book is being held. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。お戻りの際に、この札をお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Please show this tag when you return.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 何時までに戻ればいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 受取期限を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: By what time should I be back?
DLG-SC-LOC-029-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about the collection deadline. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今日は四時までにこちらへお戻りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please return here by four today.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今は二時半なので、三時半ごろに戻ります。料金は今払いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 戻る予定と支払時点を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: It's half past two now, so I'll return around half past three. Do I pay now?
DLG-SC-LOC-029-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm your return plan and when to pay. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、五百円です。御朱印帳はお受け取りのときにお返しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, five hundred yen. We'll return your seal book when you collect it.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 五百円ですね。では、この札を持って三時半に戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 金額と受取予定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Five hundred yen, right. Then I'll keep this tag and return at half past three.
DLG-SC-LOC-029-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: State the amount and collection plan. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お預かりします。どうぞお気をつけてお参りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll hold the book for you. Please take care while you visit the temple.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-09-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-09-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どちらをご覧になりたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-09-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which area would you like to see?

DLG-SC-LOC-029-09-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-09-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 池の景色を見たいです。四十分ほどで、この入口に戻れる道はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-09-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 行きたい景色と往復時間を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-09-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to see the pond scenery. Is there a path that gets us back to this entrance in about forty minutes?
DLG-SC-LOC-029-09-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: State the scenery you want to see and the round-trip time available. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-09-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-09-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この地図の池なら、往復で三十分くらいです。右手の広い道を進んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-09-001-SHARED-03.translation: For the pond on this map, the round trip is about thirty minutes. Follow the wide path on your right.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-09-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-09-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 池の周りを一周すると、時間がかかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-09-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一周にかかる時間を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-09-001-SHARED-04.translation: Does it take longer if we walk all the way around the pond?
DLG-SC-LOC-029-09-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask how long a full circuit takes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-09-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-09-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 一周するとさらに二十分ほどかかります。今日は手前の岸までがよさそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-09-001-SHARED-05.translation: Going around takes about twenty more minutes. Today it may be best to go only to the near bank.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-09-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-09-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 母と歩くので、途中に座れる場所があると助かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-09-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同行者の休憩場所を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-09-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'm walking with my mother, so somewhere to sit along the way would help.
DLG-SC-LOC-029-09-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for a rest location for your companion. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-09-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-09-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 道の途中の木陰にベンチがあります。池の手前にも休憩場所があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-09-001-SHARED-07.translation: There is a bench in the shade of the trees along the path. There is a rest area before the pond too.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-09-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-09-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 帰りに道を間違えないように、目印を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-09-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 帰路の目印を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-09-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please tell me a landmark so we don't take the wrong path back.
DLG-SC-LOC-029-09-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for a landmark on the return route. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-09-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-09-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かれ道の大きな案内板が目印です。帰りはそこで入口の矢印へ進んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-09-001-SHARED-09.translation: The large information board at the fork is the landmark. On your way back, follow the entrance arrow there.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-09-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-09-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、一周せずに池の手前まで行って戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-09-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 歩く範囲を決定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-09-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then we'll go just to the near side of the pond and return, without going all the way around.
DLG-SC-LOC-029-09-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide how far to walk. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-09-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-09-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、よいお散歩を。お気をつけてお戻りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-09-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, enjoy your walk. Take care on the way back.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-10-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-10-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どのお守りをお求めですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-10-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which good-luck charm are you looking for?

DLG-SC-LOC-029-10-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-10-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 父に渡したいので、健康のお守りを探しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-10-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 贈る相手とお守りの種類を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-10-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to give one to my father, so I'm looking for a health charm.
DLG-SC-LOC-029-10-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: State who the charm is for and what kind you want. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-10-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-10-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらに二種類あります。大きさと色が違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-10-001-SHARED-03.translation: We have these two kinds. They differ in size and color.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-10-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-10-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 父は財布に入れたいそうです。小さいほうはどのくらいの厚さですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-10-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 財布に入る厚さを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-10-001-SHARED-04.translation: My father says he'd like to put it in his wallet. How thick is the smaller one?
DLG-SC-LOC-029-10-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask about thickness for fitting it in a wallet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-10-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-10-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 薄い布の袋なので、こちらの見本を手に取ってご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-10-001-SHARED-05.translation: It's a thin cloth pouch. Please pick up this sample and look at it.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-10-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-10-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: これなら入りそうです。色は青もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-10-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 希望の色の在庫を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-10-001-SHARED-06.translation: This looks like it would fit. Do you also have it in blue?
DLG-SC-LOC-029-10-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether the desired color is available. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-10-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-10-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、青と赤があります。青をお出ししましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-10-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, we have blue and red. Shall I get a blue one?

DLG-SC-LOC-029-10-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-10-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 青を一つお願いします。離れて住む父に送るので、小さな袋も付けられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-10-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 数量と贈答用袋を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-10-001-SHARED-08.translation: One blue, please. I'm sending it to my father who lives away from me; could you include a small bag too?
DLG-SC-LOC-029-10-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request the quantity and a gift bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-10-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-10-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、お渡し用の袋に入れます。初穂料は千円です。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-10-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, we'll put it in a gift bag. The offering is one thousand yen.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-10-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-10-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 千円ですね。父には、このまま袋に入れて渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-10-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 金額と渡し方を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-10-001-SHARED-10.translation: One thousand yen, correct. I'll give it to my father in the bag as it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-029-10-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the amount and how you will give it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-10-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-10-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、どうぞ。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-10-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, here you are. Please take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-11-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-11-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 落とし物のご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-11-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about lost property?

DLG-SC-LOC-029-11-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-11-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。茶色の二つ折りの財布をなくしました。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-11-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 財布の色と形を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-11-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I've lost a brown bifold wallet.
DLG-SC-LOC-029-11-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: State the wallet's color and shape. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-11-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-11-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 最後に財布を使った場所と時刻を覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-11-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you remember where and when you last used it?

DLG-SC-LOC-029-11-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-11-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今日の一時ごろ、駅前のパン屋で使いました。その後、公園まで歩きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-11-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 最後に使った場所とその後の経路を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-11-001-SHARED-04.translation: I used it around one today at the bakery in front of the station. After that, I walked to the park.
DLG-SC-LOC-029-11-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain where you last used it and the route you took afterwards. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-11-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-11-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 財布の中に、お名前がわかるものは入っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-11-001-SHARED-05.translation: Does the wallet contain anything that shows your name?

DLG-SC-LOC-029-11-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-11-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 在留カードと銀行のカードが入っています。現金は三千円くらいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-11-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 身分証類と現金の内容を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-11-001-SHARED-06.translation: My residence card and bank card are inside. There is about three thousand yen in cash.
DLG-SC-LOC-029-11-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe the identification and cash inside. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-11-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-11-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 連絡先の電話番号を、こちらにお書きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-11-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please write your contact phone number here.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-11-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-11-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この番号です。見つかったら、本人が受け取りに来るのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-11-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 連絡先を示して受取方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-11-001-SHARED-08.translation: This is the number. If it's found, does the owner have to come and collect it?
DLG-SC-LOC-029-11-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give your contact details and ask how to collect it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-11-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-11-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受け取り方は、見つかった場所などに応じて担当からお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-11-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge will explain how to collect it depending on where it is found and other circumstances.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-11-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-11-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: わかりました。電話に出られなかった場合は、折り返します。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-11-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 折り返しの連絡を約束する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-11-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. If I miss the call, I'll call back.
DLG-SC-LOC-029-11-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Promise to return the call. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-11-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-11-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 届出をお受けします。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-11-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll accept your report. Please take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-12-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-12-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お薬の説明をしますね。飲む時間について、気になることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-12-001-SHARED-01.translation: I'll explain your medicine. Do you have any concerns about when to take it?

DLG-SC-LOC-029-12-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-12-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 袋に毎食後とありますが、仕事の日は昼ご飯が二時になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-12-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昼食が遅い勤務日を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-12-001-SHARED-02.translation: The bag says after every meal, but on workdays I have lunch at two.
DLG-SC-LOC-029-12-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that lunch is late on workdays. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-12-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-12-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 食事の時間がずれることは、よくありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-12-001-SHARED-03.translation: Does your mealtime often shift like that?

DLG-SC-LOC-029-12-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-12-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、週に三日ほどです。昼の薬は二時の食後に飲んでいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-12-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 遅い昼食後の服用を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-12-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, about three days a week. May I take the lunchtime medicine after my two-o'clock meal?
DLG-SC-LOC-029-12-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask about taking the medicine after a late lunch. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-12-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-12-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この処方について確認しますね。夕食は普段何時ごろですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-12-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check this prescription. What time do you usually have dinner?

DLG-SC-LOC-029-12-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-12-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 七時半です。昼ご飯を食べられない日もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-12-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 夕食時刻と欠食を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-12-001-SHARED-06.translation: Half past seven. There are also days when I can't eat lunch.
DLG-SC-LOC-029-12-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State your dinner time and that you sometimes skip a meal. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-12-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-12-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 食事を抜いた日の飲み方も含めて、処方内容を確認してご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-12-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll check the prescription and explain, including how to take it on days when you skip a meal.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-12-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-12-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。飲み忘れたときの説明も、紙に書いていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-12-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 飲み忘れへの説明を書面で求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-12-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. Could you also write down what to do if I forget a dose?
DLG-SC-LOC-029-12-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for written instructions about missed doses. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-12-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-12-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、この薬に合った対応を紙にまとめます。ほかに飲んでいる薬はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-12-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. I'll put the appropriate response for this medicine in writing. Are you taking any other medicines?

DLG-SC-LOC-029-12-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-12-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: このお薬手帳に載っています。一緒に飲めるかも見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-12-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: お薬手帳を渡して併用相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-12-001-SHARED-10.translation: They're listed in this medication record book. Please also check whether I can take them together.
DLG-SC-LOC-029-12-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Hand over your medication record and ask about taking medicines together. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-12-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-12-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認して説明を終えてから、お薬をお渡ししますね。お大事に。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-12-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll give you the medicine after checking and finishing the explanation. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-13-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-13-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for a jacket?

DLG-SC-LOC-029-13-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-13-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。自転車通勤で使いたいので、雨をはじくものがいいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-13-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通勤方法と求める機能を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-13-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I'd like to use it for commuting by bicycle, so I want something that repels rain.
DLG-SC-LOC-029-13-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: State how you commute and the feature you want. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-13-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-13-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらは撥水加工がしてあります。試着してみますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-13-001-SHARED-03.translation: This one has a water-repellent finish. Would you like to try it on?

DLG-SC-LOC-029-13-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-13-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。普段はＭですが、スーツの上に着たいのでＬも試したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-13-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 重ね着を考えて二サイズを試す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-13-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please. I usually wear medium, but I'd like to try large too because I want to wear it over a suit.
DLG-SC-LOC-029-13-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Try two sizes with layering in mind. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-13-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-13-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 二つお持ちします。袖の長さも比べてみてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-13-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll bring both. Please compare the sleeve lengths too.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-13-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-13-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: Ｌだと袖が長いです。Ｍで腕を前に伸ばしても、肩はきつくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-13-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 袖と肩の着心地を比べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-13-001-SHARED-06.translation: The sleeves are long in large. In medium, my shoulders aren't tight even when I stretch my arms forwards.
DLG-SC-LOC-029-13-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Compare how the sleeves and shoulders fit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-13-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-13-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: でしたらＭがよさそうですね。色は紺とベージュがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-13-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then medium looks suitable. We have navy and beige.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-13-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-13-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 紺にします。このフードは外せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-13-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 色を選んでフードの仕様を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-13-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll choose navy. Can this hood be removed?
DLG-SC-LOC-029-13-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose a color and ask about the hood. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-13-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-13-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、襟の内側のボタンで外せます。こちらをご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-13-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, with the buttons inside the collar. Please look here.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-13-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-13-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 通勤に使いやすそうです。Ｍの紺を買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-13-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: サイズと色を指定して購入する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-13-001-SHARED-10.translation: It looks convenient for commuting. I'll buy the medium in navy.
DLG-SC-LOC-029-13-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Specify the size and color and make the purchase. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-13-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-13-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。お会計へご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-13-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. I'll show you to the checkout.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-14-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-14-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。ご予約のお名前をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-14-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. May I have the name on your reservation?

DLG-SC-LOC-029-14-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-14-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 田中です。一泊の予約をしています。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-14-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 田中名義の一泊予約で到着したことをフロントに伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-14-001-SHARED-02.translation: Tanaka. I have a reservation for one night.
DLG-SC-LOC-029-14-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Tell reception you have arrived for a one-night reservation under Tanaka. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-14-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-14-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 田中様、一泊朝食付きのご予約ですね。明日の朝は何時ごろのご予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-14-001-SHARED-03.translation: Mr. Tanaka, that's one night with breakfast. What time are you planning for tomorrow morning?

DLG-SC-LOC-029-14-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-14-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 七時半のバスに乗りたいです。朝食は何時からですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-14-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 出発予定に合わせて朝食開始時刻を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-14-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd like to catch the half-past-seven bus. What time does breakfast start?
DLG-SC-LOC-029-14-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask when breakfast starts in relation to your departure plans. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-14-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-14-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 六時半からです。会場は一階で、お部屋からはエレベーターで下りられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-14-001-SHARED-05.translation: From half past six. The venue is on the first floor, and you can take the elevator down from your room.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-14-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-14-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 六時半に食べれば間に合いそうです。チェックアウト後に荷物を預けられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-14-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 朝食後の荷物預かりを頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-14-001-SHARED-06.translation: If I eat at half past six, I should make it. Can I leave my luggage after checking out?
DLG-SC-LOC-029-14-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for luggage storage after breakfast. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-14-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-14-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、フロントでお預かりします。お戻りは何時ごろですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-14-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, we can hold it at reception. Around what time will you return?

DLG-SC-LOC-029-14-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-14-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 夕方四時ごろです。割れ物が入っているので、立てて置いていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-14-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 受取予定と荷物の扱いを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-14-001-SHARED-08.translation: Around four in the afternoon. There are breakable items inside, so could you keep it upright?
DLG-SC-LOC-029-14-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State your planned collection time and how to handle the luggage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-14-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-14-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。明日お預けになる際にも、係にお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-14-001-SHARED-09.translation: Certainly. Please tell the staff again when leaving it tomorrow.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-14-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-14-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、朝食後にチェックアウトして、荷物を預けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-14-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 翌朝の行動をまとめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-14-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I'll check out after breakfast and leave the luggage.
DLG-SC-LOC-029-14-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Summarize your plan for tomorrow morning. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-14-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-14-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、こちらがお部屋の鍵です。ごゆっくりお過ごしください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-14-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. Here is your room key. Please enjoy your stay.
